line_items.description: Express Emergency Dry Cleaning (1x Silk Tie red wine extraction)
Artisanal Smoked Rosemary Almonds & Craft Botanical Tonic
'Pre-Keynote De-Stressor' Neck & Shoulder Express Massage (30 min)

reasoning: Two-night Düsseldorf stay for the Medica Expo; the nights of November 14 and 15, 2024 begin on a Thursday and a Friday, so no night falls on a weekend or public holiday and the weekend flowchart does not apply, and checking out on Saturday the 16th does not make the final night a weekend night. The note names the Medica Expo and both nights fall in November, the event window, so the trade-fair override in Chapter 9 replaces Düsseldorf's €120 Tier 3 cap with the €200 event surcharge cap; each €195 night is within the override and is reimbursed in full, and the 'Deluxe Executive Loft' category earns no higher or lower cap either way. The folio documents red-wine extraction from a silk tie ahead of the keynote, which establishes that business attire was soiled during the trip, so the €28 dry cleaning is reimbursable up to the €25 short-stay laundry cap with €3.00 deducted. Both minibar lines, including the alcoholic craft IPA, and the €65 'de-stressor' massage are deducted in full, as all spa and wellness charges are personal. City tax is reimbursed in full. VAT is allocated line by line at each line's printed rate on its deducted portion (19% on the laundry excess, the minibar, and the massage), which deducts €19.38 of the €50.99 VAT.
